# delegate reference material

The delegate kit: a harness-neutral delegation engine, the agent-definitions renderer and validator, and the delegation skills, in Python with a pytest suite.

This skill holds no copy of the documents below. Each block runs a command that reads the repository, so what you see is the branch you work on, not a snapshot.

Each block is one plain `git grep` command. Its `:/` pathspec names the file from the top of the repository, so the block works from the repository root and from each subdirectory, and in a linked worktree it reads the files of that worktree. Claude Code runs a load-time block only when it can analyse the command, and a block with `$(...)`, `;`, `if` or a pipe stops a subagent from starting. No Claude Code documentation states this rule. It is a measured behaviour: on Claude Code 2.1.283, on 2026-09-26, a compound block stopped a subagent from starting in the manual, acceptEdits and auto permission modes, and one plain command ran. The measurements are in ADR 0006 of the delegate kit, `docs/adr/0006-load-time-blocks-are-one-plain-command.md` in the repository of the kit. If a block returns an error, your session is not in the repository. If a block returns no output, its reference file can also be missing or renamed. Each path in this skill is relative to the repository root, and `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` prints that root.

A document of at most 200 lines, counted when this skill was written, is printed in full. A longer document gives its heading index and the command that reads one section of it.

## `docs/agents/delegation.md` — the gates and the hotspots

The block prints this document in full, up to 200 lines.

```!
git grep --untracked --no-exclude-standard -h -E -m 200 -e '^' -- :/docs/agents/delegation.md
```

## `AGENTS.md` — the layout of the repository

The block prints this document in full, up to 200 lines.

```!
git grep --untracked --no-exclude-standard -h -E -m 200 -e '^' -- :/AGENTS.md
```
